name: Inugamizukai to Shounen
source:
──You go to see the cherry blossoms?
──To go count the petals of the Yaezakura.

In the middle of the opening ceremony.
A boy encounters another mysterious boy in the shade of the cherry trees above.

──She's only visible to me, right?
──The girl hanging there, I mean.

What he had seen, was it a dream or an illusion?
Or perhaps──it was reality?

Led by an eccentric woman called Kureha, both youths are confronted with real youkai – living, breathing dog spirits that appeared in front of their very eyes.

"You have incurred the wrath of the 'Inugamisuji'."

[Translated from [url=https://ugainovel.web.fc2.com/inugami/]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
——你要去看樱花吗？

——去数八重樱的花瓣。

在开学典礼进行到一半时，

一个男孩在樱树上方的树荫里遇到了另一个神秘男孩。

——她只有我能看见，对吧？

——我是说，那个挂在那里的人。

他看见的究竟是梦，还是幻觉？

又或者——那就是现实？

在名叫红叶的古怪女人引领下，两个少年面对了真实存在的妖怪——活生生的犬神，它们出现在他们眼前。

“你招致了‘犬神筋’的愤怒。”

[译自 [url=https://ugainovel.web.fc2.com/inugami/]官方网站[/url]]
